scale_videooptimizer.title: VideoOptimizer
scale_videooptimizer.settings_intro: Store the organization-wide API token. Editors then never need to log in to VideoOptimizer themselves.
scale_videooptimizer.api_token_placehold: vp_… (leave empty to keep the existing token)
scale_videooptimizer.token_missing: No token has been configured yet.
scale_videooptimizer.remove_token_confir: Really remove the stored API token? Editors will no longer be able to pick or upload videos until a new token is saved.
scale_videooptimizer.not_configured: No VideoOptimizer token is configured. Please set it up under Settings first.
scale_videooptimizer.upload_hint: Choose a video file and upload it. Processing can take a few minutes.
scale_videooptimizer.processing_failed: Processing failed — the video could not be encoded.
scale_videooptimizer.no_videos: This library does not contain any videos yet.
scale_videooptimizer.confirm_delete_libr: Permanently delete this library and all its videos?
scale_videooptimizer.confirm_reprocess: Re-queue all videos in this library for reprocessing?
scale_videooptimizer.poster_unsupported_: Unsupported image type. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
scale_videooptimizer.poster_failed: The poster could not be processed.
scale_videooptimizer.select_library_hint: Please select a library above to upload or ingest a video.
scale_videooptimizer.addon_hint: Paid add-on — not yet unlocked for your organization.
scale_videooptimizer.delivery_only_hint: This library is delivery-only. Encoding ladder, upload and poster are unavailable.
scale_videooptimizer.ladder_reprocess_hi: After saving, use "Reprocess" so the changed encoding ladder takes effect.
scale_videooptimizer.select_or_create_hi: Select a library above or create a new one.
scale_videooptimizer.ingest_url_help: Public https link to the video file itself, e.g. https://example.com/video.mp4.
scale_videooptimizer.ingest_platform_lin: Link to a video file, not to a video page. Video platforms such as YouTube cannot be imported.
scale_videooptimizer.encoding_quality_he: Performance: compact files, fast start. Quality: visibly sharper, about 2.5–3× the CDN traffic.
scale_videooptimizer.quality_reprocess_h: After saving, run "Reprocess" with "Re-encode all qualities" so existing videos use the new quality mode.
scale_videooptimizer.reprocess_force: Re-encode all qualities (also videos that are already processed)
scale_videooptimizer.poll_timeout: Timed out while waiting for VideoOptimizer. Reload the list and check the status.
scale_videooptimizer.error_token_rejecte: VideoOptimizer rejected the API token. Check the token under VideoOptimizer > Settings.
scale_videooptimizer.error_token_forbidd: The API token is not permitted to do this. Check the token permissions in VideoOptimizer.
scale_videooptimizer.error_forbidden: Your Sulu role does not allow this VideoOptimizer action. Ask an administrator to grant the permission under Settings > User roles.
scale_videooptimizer.error_unreachable: VideoOptimizer could not be reached or did not respond in time. Please try again in a moment.
scale_videooptimizer.no_subtitles: This video has no subtitles yet.
scale_videooptimizer.subtitle_help: SRT or WebVTT file, up to 2 MB. A subtitle in the same language is replaced. Only for libraries that manage their own media.
scale_videooptimizer.subtitle_saved_skip: Subtitle saved; {count} malformed cue(s) were skipped.
scale_videooptimizer.subtitle_too_large: The subtitle file is larger than 2 MB.
scale_videooptimizer.subtitle_languages_: No subtitle languages yet. Add them under VideoOptimizer > Settings first.
Languages that subtitles can be uploaded in. They are shared by all videos and appear in the player menu in this order.
scale_videooptimizer.subtitle_language_h: The code cannot be changed later. Without a name the language's own name is used.
scale_videooptimizer.subtitle_language_d: Delete the subtitle language "{language}"? This is only possible when no video has a subtitle in it.
scale_videooptimizer.error_subtitle_lang: Videos still have subtitles in this language. Delete those subtitles first.
scale_videooptimizer.tags_help: Comma-separated. Tags are shared by all libraries; up to 20 per video.
scale_videooptimizer.tags_too_many: A video can have at most 20 tags.
scale_videooptimizer.tag_too_long: A tag can have at most 50 characters.
scale_videooptimizer.metadata_help: Your own key/value data on the video, e.g. the ID of the page it belongs to. Up to 10 entries; keys in lower case (a-z, 0-9, _ . -), values up to 64 characters.
scale_videooptimizer.metadata_key_invali: A metadata key needs 1-40 characters: lower-case letters, digits, _ . and -.
scale_videooptimizer.metadata_key_duplic: A metadata key is used twice.
scale_videooptimizer.metadata_too_many: A video can have at most 10 metadata entries.
scale_videooptimizer.savings_help: Compared with serving the original files. Bandwidth figures are estimates; video traffic is tracked from October 2026.
scale_videooptimizer.webhook_intro: VideoOptimizer can notify this site when a video is ready or has failed. The site then refreshes the cached video data and pages right away instead of waiting for the cache to expire.
scale_videooptimizer.webhook_missing: No webhook secret yet: the receiver is disabled and answers 503.
scale_videooptimizer.webhook_url_help: Enter this URL when you create the webhook in VideoOptimizer (Integrations > Webhooks). If the admin runs on another domain than the website, use the website's domain.
scale_videooptimizer.webhook_secret_plac: Signing secret from VideoOptimizer (leave empty to keep the existing one)
scale_videooptimizer.webhook_never: No webhook has been received yet. Use "Send test" in VideoOptimizer to check the setup.
scale_videooptimizer.webhook_remove_conf: Really remove the webhook secret? The receiver will refuse all deliveries until a new secret is saved.
scale_videooptimizer.error_webhook_table: The webhook table does not exist yet. Run "bin/adminconsole scale:videooptimizer:install" and save again.
